name: AgentCenter Bridge
description: Persistent WebSocket bridge between this OpenClaw instance and AgentCenter Cloud for live task delivery and agent status reporting.
author: AgentCenter Cloud

agentCenterUrl.description: WebSocket URL of AgentCenter Cloud live gateway, e.g. wss://your-instance.agentcenter.cloud/live-gateway

token.description: One-time setup key from the Live Gateway wizard. Replaced by a permanent key after first connect.

fingerprint.description: Stable machine fingerprint. Leave blank to auto-derive from hostname + MAC.

reconnectBaseMs.description: Reconnect backoff base interval in milliseconds. Default: 2000

reconnectMaxMs.description: Maximum reconnect backoff in milliseconds. Default: 30000
